Get ACB Play-by-Play

Source: R/acb.R
acb_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a game (2016-17 onward): every shot, rebound, foul, turnover, substitution and time-out.

One row per event. play_type is the API's event code and play_name its bundle name (acb_codes.PLAY_TYPES; a code outside the table, such as the minute marker 600, has no name); turnover_type decodes play_tag. The clock counts DOWN: minute / second are the time left in the period and clock_seconds the same in seconds. order is not unique (the starting five share one); play_index is the 1-based position in the feed. is_home is true for the home team's events (the feed's local). run_* columns are the acting player's running box score AFTER the event. Games before 2016-17 answer no events (the wrapper raises hoopR_no_data).

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/matchdata/PlayByPlay/play-by-play

Usage

acb_pbp(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(required) ACB match id (integer), one global sequence for every competition: legacy ids (seasons up to 2019-20) sit below about 20000 (12559 = the 2005-06 final); ids from 2020-21 start around 100000 (105401 = Barca 89-86 Valencia Basket, Liga 2026-27 round 3). A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per record described above; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py acb_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerACB match id (one global sequence for every competition; legacy ids are below about 20000 up to 2019-20, ids from 2020-21 start around 100000). Taken from the request when the body does not name the game.
edition_idintegerSeason id (editionId) = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27). The wrappers take the END year, season.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27) = edition_id + 1936: the key the wrappers take.
play_indexinteger1-based position of the event in the feed (the feed's order key is not unique).
orderintegerEvent order key, ascending through the game (10, 301, 401, ...); not contiguous and not unique (the starting five share one).
quarterintegerPeriod of the event: 1-4 quarters, 5+ overtimes.
minuteintegerGame clock left in the period, minutes part (10 at tip-off; overtimes are 5 minutes).
secondintegerGame clock left in the period, seconds part.
clock_secondsintegerGame clock REMAINING in the period as whole seconds (minute x 60 + second; the clock counts down from 600, overtimes from 300).
play_typeintegerEvent code (acb_codes.PLAY_TYPES decodes it; 599 = starting lineup, one row per starter at 10:00).
play_namecharacterBundle name of play_type (acb_codes.PLAY_TYPES, e.g. TWO_POINTER_MADE); null for a code outside the enum such as the minute marker 600.
play_tagintegerTurnover detail code on turnovers (acb_codes.PLAY_TAGS); null otherwise.
turnover_typecharacterName of the turnover detail play_tag (acb_codes.PLAY_TAGS, e.g. BAD_PASS); null when there is no tag or the tag is unmapped.
is_homelogicalTrue when the event belongs to the home team (the API's local); false for the away team and for neutral events.
score_homeintegerHome score after the event.
score_awayintegerAway score after the event.
license_typeintegerLicence class of the player (202 on every player event); meaning unverified; null on team and clock events.
player_idintegerACB licence number of the player; null on team and clock events.
player_namecharacterPlayer display name; null on team and clock events.
shirt_numbercharacterShirt number as a string; null on starting-lineup rows and on team events.
run_pointsintegerThe acting player's running points AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_free_throws_madeintegerThe acting player's running free throws made AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_free_throws_attemptedintegerThe acting player's running free throws attempted AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_two_pointers_madeintegerThe acting player's running two pointers made AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_two_pointers_attemptedintegerThe acting player's running two pointers attempted AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_three_pointers_madeintegerThe acting player's running three pointers made AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_three_pointers_attemptedintegerThe acting player's running three pointers attempted AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_assistsintegerThe acting player's running assists AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_off_reboundsintegerThe acting player's running off rebounds AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_def_reboundsintegerThe acting player's running def rebounds AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_total_reboundsintegerThe acting player's running total rebounds AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_stealsintegerThe acting player's running steals AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_turnoversintegerThe acting player's running turnovers AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_blocksintegerThe acting player's running blocks AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_personal_foulsintegerThe acting player's running personal fouls AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
run_fouls_drawnintegerThe acting player's running fouls drawn AFTER this event (cumulative in the game).
series_winsintegerHome team's series wins, on the END_OF_GAME event of a 2016-17 playoff game only.
series_lossesintegerHome team's series losses, on the same event.

Details

  • Legal notice (sdv-internal-refs/acb/README.md, aviso legal of acb.com read 2026-10-12): ACEB, S.A.U. claims intellectual property in the site's databases (the EU sui generis database right) among its other content. It authorises viewing and private copies for personal or journalistic use with the source credited, and requires prior express consent for distribution, reproduction or public communication. These wrappers fetch on the user's behalf; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's decision first. robots.txt allows the paths.

  • Unofficial and unsupported: api2.acb.com is the .NET API behind acb.com and live.acb.com, not a documented public API. It needs the header X-APIKEY, a public key shipped in acb.com's bundle: the runtime sends the documented value ($ACB_API_KEY overrides it), re-reads the live bundle once on a 401, and never prints the key.

  • Seasons: the API keys a season by editionId = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27, 48 = 1983-84, the first). The wrappers take season, the END year (2027 = 2026-27), and the runtime sends editionId = season - 1936. A route that omits season serves the current edition. team_id is a season-team entry (new every season); club_id is the stable club.

  • Coverage: box scores from 1983-84 (old seasons carry only the whole-game period, quarter 0); play-by-play and shots from 2016-17 (earlier games answer empty lists, which raise hoopR_no_data). Shot coordinates come in two systems, split by match id: millimetres from the attacked basket from 2020-21 (coord_system mm), a 0-100 full-court percent grid before (grid). A game that is not finished (matchFinished false) raises hoopR_asset_fetch for the routes that report it.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404 / 204, a route whose rows are empty: an unknown id, a game outside a playoff series, play-by-play or shots before 2016-17, a club with no games that season), hoopR_bad_request (a missing, unknown or non-integer argument or a season before 1984, raised before any request; HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a key the API still rejects after one re-read of the bundle, any other non-200 after three attempts, a non-JSON or problem+json body, an error envelope or empty stub, a body for another season, round, club, player or match, a game that is not finished). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
